# Code, with room to think

Keep `Result<T, E>` close to the words it belongs to.

```rust
fn greeting(name: &str) -> String {
    format!("Hello, {name}")
}
```

```typescript
interface Theme {
    name: string;
    colors: Record<string, string>;
}
```

> A small thought can become a new beginning.
